verdict.rationale: Zep documents a concrete claim ('sub-200ms context retrieval regardless of graph size') and reiterates it in quick-start docs, giving platform engineers a specific latency target. However, this is a first-party marketing claim without published p50/p95 methodology, benchmark data, test conditions, or independent verification. Missing for 10: measured p50/p95 numbers with methodology, independent benchmarks or hands-on corroboration, and detail on how latency scales under real-world load.
